tasks.title: Expose simplified check-stage task and checks
tasks.description: Refactor the check-stage happy path so `ai-review` is persisted and emitted as the visible check-stage task, not as a check. Replace the default visible checks with `review-passed`, `merge-ready`, and `user-approval`, and update check-suite defaults/types to use those public names for new runs.
acceptanceCriteria: A default check-stage execution records `ai-review` as the initial visible task result
A default check-stage execution records visible check results named `review-passed`, `merge-ready`, and `user-approval` only
New active CheckSuite state initializes checks for `review-passed`, `merge-ready`, and `user-approval` and does not initialize `build-test` or `ai-review` check keys
Legacy check-suite reads tolerate existing `ai-review` check data when practical, but new writes use the simplified keys
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep internal review artifact rounds in logs/session events if useful, but do not expose them as first-class stage tasks or checks. This task produces the public naming contract that later tasks consume.

tasks.title: Make ai-review own review artifact validity
tasks.description: Move review artifact existence, format, and verdict parsing validation into the `ai-review` task contract. Missing `review.md`, malformed review format, or an unparsable verdict must fail the `ai-review` task before `review-passed` is treated as an ordinary user-visible check failure.
acceptanceCriteria: When `review.md` is missing after review generation and retry, the `ai-review` task result is failed and no additional user-visible check is created for artifact validation
When `review.md` exists but verdict parsing fails, the `ai-review` task result is failed and `review-passed` is not reported as the user-facing cause
When `review.md` contains a parseable PASS verdict, `ai-review` completes and `review-passed` can pass using that artifact
Internal health or artifact retry evidence remains available in task output or logs without adding `health:check` or artifact-validation checks to the visible check list
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task consumes the simplified public task/check model from T-001 and hardens the `ai-review` task boundary.

tasks.title: Create dynamic review repair loop
tasks.description: Change review failure handling so `review-passed` FAIL dynamically creates actual repair work based on review findings. After repair completes, invalidate stale review artifacts/checkpoints and rerun the full `ai-review` task before checking `review-passed` again.
acceptanceCriteria: A FAIL verdict from `review-passed` creates a concrete repair task only when review findings require repair
No pending or skipped `fix-review-findings` task is predeclared before review failure occurs
After review repair changes code, old `review.md` and review checkpoint state are invalidated before re-review
After repair, the regenerated final `review.md` describes the current code and is the artifact parsed by `review-passed`
If re-review still fails, the latest failure is preserved and ordinary user approval is not requested
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use the existing review repair implementation where possible, but trigger it from `review-passed` rather than an `ai-review` check policy.

tasks.title: Implement merge-ready snapshot invalidation
tasks.description: Make `merge-ready` the user-visible mergeability verifier for the reviewed candidate snapshot. If merge-readiness work rebases, resolves conflicts, or otherwise changes `HEAD`, reset the current review truth and rerun `ai-review` before allowing `review-passed` and approval to continue.
acceptanceCriteria: `merge-ready` passes when the reviewed candidate can be merged into the target branch without changing the candidate snapshot
`merge-ready` failure records target branch and conflict or mergeability evidence without exposing `merge-readiness` as a check name
When merge-readiness repair changes `HEAD`, active review/check-suite state is reset for the new snapshot
After a code-changing merge-readiness repair, `ai-review` reruns and `review-passed` is based on the new review artifact
Approval is not requested when `merge-ready` is failed or when review truth belongs to an older snapshot
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not expand integrate-stage merge behavior. This task only ensures check-stage mergeability and review invalidation are correct before approval.

tasks.title: Update API, CLI, and Web UI presentation
tasks.description: Update issue APIs, approval validation, CLI rendering, SSE consumers, and Web UI types/hooks to consume the simplified public model. Users should see `ai-review` as work and only `review-passed`, `merge-ready`, and approval as decision points.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number and GET /api/issues/:number/check-suite expose the simplified check names for new check-stage runs
POST /api/issues/:number/approve validates the current approval snapshot against `review-passed` PASS, `merge-ready` PASS, current HEAD, and worktree cleanliness
CLI issue detail no longer presents `health:check`, `merge-readiness`, `integration-health-gate-preview`, or `ai-review` as user-visible checks for new runs
Web UI check-suite progress defaults and optimistic updates use `review-passed`, `merge-ready`, and `user-approval`
Done or integration evidence no longer requires `integration-health-gate-preview` or `merge-readiness` check records to render useful information
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task consumes the backend state and event names from T-001 through T-004. Keep user labels friendly, but keep API/domain keys consistent with the runner.

tasks.title: Add simplified check-stage regression tests
tasks.description: Add or update regression tests that prove the simplified check-stage model end to end. Cover task/check separation, artifact validation failures, dynamic review repair, merge-ready snapshot invalidation, approval gating, and API/UI-facing check-suite shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Test proves the initial visible check-stage task is `ai-review` and visible checks are `review-passed`, `merge-ready`, and `user-approval`
Test proves missing or unparsable `review.md` fails the `ai-review` task rather than adding a visible artifact-validation check
Test proves `review-passed` FAIL creates a real repair task, reruns `ai-review`, and uses the regenerated review artifact
Test proves merge-ready code changes invalidate old review truth and require a new `ai-review` before approval
Test proves approval is rejected when review-passed, merge-ready, snapshot SHA, or worktree cleanliness is stale or failing
Relevant workflow/API/Web UI tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer focused deterministic tests with mocked agent/git helpers. This task depends on all implementation tasks because it verifies the final integrated behavior.
